description: The SQL type scope of MEOS functions whose scope MEOS itself does not state. A function sharing a PG wrapper with others receives only the wrapper's signatures that its scope covers; parser/typescope.py derives that scope from a VALIDATE_* macro, MeosType literals, a class predicate or the C parameter types, and every claimant it cannot derive must be declared here. A scope of "*" means the function genuinely serves every overload its wrapper declares.

temporal_append_tinstant.note: Generic over Temporal *: appends to any temporal type.

temporal_at_values.note: Generic over Temporal *: restricts any temporal type to a value set.

temporal_minus_values.note: Generic over Temporal *: the complement of temporal_at_values.

temporal_end_instant.note: Generic over Temporal *: accessor on any temporal type.

temporal_start_instant.note: Generic over Temporal *: accessor on any temporal type.

temporal_end_sequence.note: Generic over Temporal *: accessor on any temporal type.

temporal_start_sequence.note: Generic over Temporal *: accessor on any temporal type.

temporal_set_interp.note: Generic over Temporal *: sets the interpolation of any temporal type.

temporal_scale_time.note: Generic over Temporal *: scales the time of any temporal type.

temporal_shift_time.note: Generic over Temporal *: shifts the time of any temporal type.

temporal_shift_scale_time.note: Generic over Temporal *: shifts and scales the time of any temporal type.

spanset_span.note: Generic over SpanSet *: returns the bounding span of any spanset type.

span_lower_inc.note: Generic over Span *: reports whether the lower bound of any span type is inclusive.

span_upper_inc.note: Generic over Span *: reports whether the upper bound of any span type is inclusive.

trgeometry_at_values.note: Serves trgeometry alone. It states no validity check of its own, so the scope cannot be read from the body — see the rgeo restrict functions, which delegate without validating.

trgeometry_minus_values.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_at_tstzspan.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_at_tstzset.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_at_tstzspanset.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_minus_tstzspan.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_minus_tstzset.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_minus_tstzspanset.note: Serves trgeometry alone; states no validity check.

trgeometry_at_value.note: Serves trgeometry alone. Its operand is a Temporal *, and the only parameter naming a type is the pose restricted to, so the parameter types name the value rather than the temporal type.

trgeometry_minus_value.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the pose, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_at_timestamptz.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the timestamp, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_minus_timestamptz.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the timestamp, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_at_geom.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the geometry restricted to, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_minus_geom.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the geometry, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_at_stbox.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the box and the border flag, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_minus_stbox.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its parameter types name the box and the border flag, not the temporal type.

trgeometry_as_text.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its only remaining parameter is the digit count, whose type names nothing it serves.

trgeometry_as_ewkt.note: Serves trgeometry alone; its only remaining parameter is the digit count, whose type names nothing it serves.

tintbox_shift_scale.note: Shifts and scales a tbox. Its body names the value span it moves (T_INTSPAN), so the span is what a body-read derives — the type it serves is the box.

tbigintbox_shift_scale.note: Shifts and scales a tbox; the body names its value span, not the box.

tfloatbox_shift_scale.note: Shifts and scales a tbox; the body names its value span, not the box.

nad_tint_tbox.note: The tint arm of the tnumber/tbox nearest-approach set.

nad_tbigint_tbox.note: The tbigint arm of the tnumber/tbox nearest-approach set.

nad_tfloat_tbox.note: The tfloat arm of the tnumber/tbox nearest-approach set.
